{{Top}}
'''Astrotours Limited''' was a front company supposedly offering "adventure cruises" to [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. [[Bant Defula]] was a senior executive. In reality, it was a front for the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], and to acquire funds to house [[Lumiya]].
